Narcissism (NPI-16)

A 16-item forced-choice narcissism measure.

l: npi
t: multiradio 2
o: random
o: scores 0 1
q: For each pair of statements, choose the one you identify with most.
- When people compliment me I sometimes get embarrassed
- I know that I am good because everybody keeps telling me so
- I prefer to blend in with the crowd
- I like to be the center of attention

References

  • Ames, D. R., Rose, P., & Anderson, C. P. (2006). The NPI-16. Journal of Research in Personality, 40, 440-450.
